findings.title: 12 of 13 ATP Tennis fixtures and 6 of 7 featured Tennis predictions in /slate/ do not exist on official ATP draws
findings.detail: Direct fetches of official ATP daily schedules for Almaty (9410), Brussels (7485), and Lyon (496) prove 12/13 ATP fixtures in data/slate/matches.json are non-existent pairings involving eliminated players (Rinky Hijikata lost Oct 20 to Terence Atmane; Martin Landaluce lost Oct 21 to Stan Wawrinka) or players competing in different countries (Tomas Machac is in Almaty vs Karen Khachanov, not in Brussels vs Lorenzo Musetti; Flavio Cobolli is top seed in Lyon vs Wawrinka, not in Almaty; Damir Dzumhur is in Brussels vs Zizou Bergs, not in Lyon vs Tommy Paul).
findings.portal_resolution: Replaced all fabricated pairings with 16 live ATP & WTA matches verified directly on atptour.com and wtatennis.com.

findings.title: Fabricated PDC withdrawal claiming Ritchie Edhouse replaced Stephen Bunting against Danny Noppert
findings.detail: data/slate/predictions.json #9 asserts an Oct 21 PDC preview replaced withdrawn (28) Stephen Bunting with #33 Ritchie Edhouse. Official PDC draw, schedule of play, and preview pages plus live olbg.com event_id=32330 confirm (5) Danny Noppert v (28) Stephen Bunting is active on Thursday Oct 22 in Dortmund.
findings.portal_resolution: Restored verified (5) Danny Noppert vs (28) Stephen Bunting across all PDC Round 1 tables and predictions.

findings.title: PGA Tour Bank of Utah Championship (ended Oct 4, won by Austin Smotherman -26) listed on Oct 22 active slates; Genesis field size misstated as 120
findings.detail: Official pgatour.com/tournaments/2026/bank-of-utah-championship/R2026554 confirms the tournament finished Oct 1-4, 2026. Meanwhile live Oct 22-25 OLBG Golf events Butterfield Bermuda Championship (R2026528, OLBG 101904) and Stifel Charity Classic (S2026625, OLBG 101903) were omitted, and DP World Tour Genesis Championship was labeled 120 players instead of official 126 (90 DPWT + 36 KPGA).
findings.portal_resolution: Removed completed Utah event; originated live Bermuda & Genesis 72-hole tournament matchups and flagged 120/126-player full-field outrights.

findings.title: Live Oct 22-23 Lyon, Ningbo, and Osaka matches mislabeled as next week's Basel, Vienna, and Guangzhou tournaments
findings.detail: Swiss Indoors Basel (328), Erste Bank Open Vienna (337), and WTA Guangzhou (1023) run Oct 26 - Nov 1, 2026 with draws not yet made. Cobolli vs Wawrinka and Moutet vs Paul are live in Lyon (ATP 496), Shnaider vs Eala is in Ningbo (WTA 2092), and Gibson vs Krueger is in Osaka (WTA 405).
findings.portal_resolution: Mapped every ATP/WTA fixture to its exact Oct 22-23 tournament venue and official draw URL.

findings.category: Model Probability vs Editorial Conviction Disclosure
findings.affected_layer: forward, board, hub, slate (documented in evidence/audit.json)
findings.title: Cross-layer ambiguity between >=70% probability picks (-250..-233) and multi-factor conviction picks (-225..+315)
findings.detail: As noted in evidence/audit.json, 2-way fair no-vig odds for p >= 70% occupy only [-250, -233] inside [-250, +10000], whereas broader in-band picks at -220..+315 have p < 70%.
findings.portal_resolution: /portal/ labels both exact p_model and explicit sub-tier ('Tier H1: >=70% Probability In-Band' vs 'Tier H2: Multi-Factor High-Conviction In-Band') on every pick card.
